description: Create a price rule (the policy that governs discounts — percentage/fixed amount, prerequisites, entitlements, usage caps). Pair with create_discount_code to mint a usable code.

price_rule.description: Shopify price_rule object. Required: title, target_type ('line_item' | 'shipping_line'), target_selection ('all' | 'entitled'), allocation_method ('across' | 'each'), value_type ('percentage' | 'fixed_amount'), value (negative string, e.g. '-10.0'), customer_selection ('all' | 'prerequisite'), starts_at. Optional: ends_at, usage_limit, once_per_customer, prerequisite_subtotal_range, entitled_product_ids, entitled_collection_ids.

name: create_price_rule
